details.raw_sql:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT 
        event_date,
        DATE(event_date) AS dt,
        session_id,
        action,
        label,
        page_name,
        order_id,
        service_line,
        ui_page_category,
        user_device_type,
        category
    FROM silver_layer.t_link_journey_checkout_com
    WHERE 
        {{date}}
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{servie_line}})
            OR LOWER(service_line) = LOWER({{servie_line}})
            OR LOWER(ui_page_category) = LOWER({{servie_line}})
        )
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{os_naame}})
            OR LOWER(user_device_type) = LOWER({{os_naame}})
        )
        AND LOWER(category) <> 'addonmanagement'
        AND (
            'All' IN ({{category}})
            OR LOWER(category) = LOWER({{category}})
        )
        [[ AND {{natco}} ]]
),
basket_sessions AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        event_date AS basket_event_date,
        dt AS basket_dt,
        session_id
    FROM base
    WHERE 
        LOWER(action) = 'pageview'
        AND LOWER(page_name) LIKE '%basket%'
),
session_flags AS (
    SELECT
        b.basket_event_date AS event_date,
        b.basket_dt AS dt,
        b.session_id,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(base.page_name) LIKE '%checkout/account%'
             AND LOWER(base.action) = 'pageview'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS registration_page_optional,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(base.page_name) LIKE '%checkout/personalinfo%'
             AND LOWER(base.action) = 'pageview'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS personalinfo_page,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(base.page_name) LIKE '%checkout/identification%'
             AND LOWER(base.action) = 'pageview'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS ident_page_optional,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(base.page_name) LIKE '%checkout/appointment%'
             AND LOWER(base.action) = 'pageview'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS appointment_page_optional,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(base.page_name) LIKE '%checkout/payment%'
             AND LOWER(base.action) = 'pageview'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS payment_page,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(base.page_name) LIKE '%consent%'
             AND LOWER(base.action) = 'pageview'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS orderreview_page,
        MAX(CASE 
            WHEN LOWER(base.action) = 'purchasesuccess'
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END) AS order_placed
    FROM basket_sessions b
    LEFT JOIN base
        ON b.session_id = base.session_id
    GROUP BY
        b.basket_event_date,
        b.basket_dt,
        b.session_id
),
funnel_counts AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc(
            CASE 
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily'   THEN 'day'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly'  THEN 'week'
                WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN 'month'
            END,
            dt
        ) AS period_sort,
        CASE 
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'daily' THEN
                format_datetime(dt, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'weekly' THEN
                CONCAT(
                    format_datetime(date_trunc('week', dt), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),
                    ' -Wk',
                    CAST(week_of_year(dt) AS VARCHAR)
                )
            WHEN {{time_granularity}} = 'monthly' THEN
                format_datetime(date_trunc('month', dt), 'MMM-yyyy')
        END AS period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT session_id)          AS basket_page,
        SUM(registration_page_optional)     AS registration_page_optional,
        SUM(personalinfo_page)              AS personalinfo_page,
        SUM(ident_page_optional)            AS ident_page_optional,
        SUM(appointment_page_optional)      AS appointment_page_optional,
        SUM(payment_page)                   AS payment_page,
        SUM(orderreview_page)               AS orderreview_page,
        SUM(order_placed)                   AS order_placed
    FROM session_flags
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
    period,
    basket_page,
    ROUND(registration_page_optional * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS "registration_page_(optional)",
    ROUND(personalinfo_page          * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS personalinfo_page,
    ROUND(ident_page_optional        * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS "ident_page_(optional)",
    ROUND(appointment_page_optional  * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS "appointment_page_(optional)",
    ROUND(payment_page               * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS payment_page,
    ROUND(orderreview_page           * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS orderreview_page,
    ROUND(order_placed               * 1.0 / NULLIF(basket_page, 0), 3) AS order_placed
FROM funnel_counts
ORDER BY period_sort;
